integrity: A complete mathematical proof and a standalone finite verifier are provided. Computation does not replace the all-parameter proof; no independent scientific audit is claimed.
limitations: Cyclic unsentinelled binary BWT only; input must contain both bits and avoid 11 cyclically for the transformation formula. The exact 2m−2 run law concerns the substitution powers, not arbitrary prefixes. Bibliographic novelty has residual unindexed-source risk.
title: An exact cyclic Burrows–Wheeler recursion for period-doubling words
